****_Batman_ (Volume 2) #4**** is an issue of the series [_Batman_ (Volume 2)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batman_Vol_2 "Batman Vol 2") with a cover date of [February, 2012](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2012,_February "Category:2012, February"). It was published on December 21, 2011.

## Synopsis for "Face the Court (Part 1 of 2)"

After setting off a trip-wire in one of the Court of Owls' hideaways within his family's buildings, [Batman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batman_(Bruce_Wayne) "Batman (Bruce Wayne)") is faced with the aftermath of the explosion, dodging debris. After having discovered several of these hideouts dating as far back as the 19th century, he tripped a wire. Focused, he fires his grapple through a weak wall and escapes out into the night. In the [Batcave](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Batcave "Batcave"), [Dick Grayson](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Richard_Grayson_(Prime_Earth) "Richard Grayson (Prime Earth)") marvels at the fact that his mentor appears to be resting. That is, until [Alfred](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Alfred_Pennyworth_(Prime_Earth) "Alfred Pennyworth (Prime Earth)") admits that he has been drugging his charge in order to force him to stop working. When Bruce wakes, Dick finds him analyzing a set of bones belonging to [Alan Wayne](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Alan_Wayne_(Prime_Earth) "Alan Wayne (Prime Earth)"). Dick has spoken with the [Commissioner](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/James_Gordon_(Prime_Earth) "James Gordon (Prime Earth)") about the case, and both of them have noticed that Batman is strangely skeptical of the Court of Owls' existence, despite all evidence to the contrary.

Bruce explains that the lesson he learned was never to let his emotions guide him in a case. He had needed there to be a Court of Owls, and that need had nearly got him killed. Dick responds that while Gotham has belonged to Bruce and the Waynes for generations, the city is much older than that. In its four hundred years, perhaps Gotham had been controlled by something else; something much darker than a Batman.
